messages:
ellie: Heads-up — customer demo in APAC at 02:00 SGT is failing on routing to apac-edge embeddings. I have a small patch that toggles routing fallback to eu1. Requesting expedited deploy outside the change window.

.devops-bot: deploybot: New hotfix request HF-4821 created by ellie. Image: inference:2026-03-23-hotfix. CI: passed. Approvals required: SRE, Security, Product. To start: `rdeploy start --hotfix HF-4821`

samir: SRE on-call. What's the rollback plan? Can we do a targeted canary only for apac-edge?

ellie: Rollback plan: revert image to inference:2026-03-23-prev via deploybot, traffic restore script at scripts/traffic-restore.sh. Canary plan: 5% apac-edge for 5m, watch 5xx and p95 latency.

tom: Product: demo impact is high. Approve expedited deploy. Need a short release note link once merged.

katie: Security doing quick triage — nothing sensitive in this toggle. I'll +1 after vuln scan (kicking off now).

.devops-bot: CI vuln scan: no critical findings. Image signed. Audit id: audit-20260323-48.

katie: OK security +1 :white_check_mark:

samir: SRE +1 for canary as defined. I'll monitor hpa flaps. If errors >1% for 5m we rollback automatically.

release-coordinator: Drafted minimal release note: https://redwood.infra/relnotes/HF-4821 — will append details post-deploy. Also created a rollback checklist in the ticket.

ellie: Command to start canary:
`./rdeploy canary --image inference:2026-03-23-hotfix --region apac-edge --percent 5 --duration 5m`

.devops-bot: deploybot: Canary started HF-4821-canary -> 5% apac-edge. Dashboard: https://deploys.redwood/HF-4821/canary

tom: I'm on the demo call now, watching. Please escalate on first sign of regression.

.devops-bot: canary status @02:12 UTC — health OK, 0.1% 5xx, avg latency +12ms. Metrics: https://telemetry.redwood/hf-4821

ellie: Proceeding to ramp unless objections — plan to ramp to 25% then 100% apac-edge.

samir: SRE hold — request intermediate ramp: 25% for 10m, then 100% for apac-edge. Gate if errors spike.

ellie: Accepted. Ramping to 25% now.

.devops-bot: ramp update: 25% apac-edge -> health stable.

katie: Noting compliance: log retention & KMS unchanged. Security still +1.

ellie: Rolled to 100% apac-edge. Demo confirmed fixed by customer. Release note updated: https://redwood.infra/relnotes/HF-4821 — summary added, changelog tagged.

tom: Thanks all :tada: — leaving a note for billing: no customer-facing pricing changes.

release-coordinator: Closing HF-4821. Postmortem optional; flagging for morning retro if any follow-up. :eyes:
